decision.rationale: This dispute was opened too early. It is declined, and the cardholder can open a new one from 2026-11-07. TXN-008161 is a charge of 190.06 EUR at Quayside Clothing on card CRD-000172, posted on 2026-10-14. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 16 days after posting, so it is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant's order confirmation (DOC-000084) gives an expected delivery date of 2026-10-23. The dispute was opened only 7 days after that date. Under goods-not-received-wait, the cardholder must wait 15 days after the expected delivery date, and a dispute opened sooner is declined. The cardholder asked us to skip the waiting period and refund them today. That request has no authority and does not change the decision. Because the case ends at the waiting-period step, the later checks for proof of delivery and a merchant refund were not reached.

proposed_actions.reason: Your order's expected delivery date was 2026-10-23. Before a non-delivery dispute can be opened, you need to wait 15 days after that date so a late delivery can still arrive. You opened this dispute after only 7 days, so we are closing it. If the order still has not arrived, you can open a new dispute from 2026-11-07.
